purpose: Discover whether stocks with prior positive price information but weak turnover response to lagged positive returns form a chart-reviewable A-share underreaction mother. The economic object is a paper-inspired turnover-PFC relation, not canonical volume-PFC, turnover level, raw momentum, a one-day volume shock, or a candle pattern.

pre_stage_a_semantic_amendment.timing: Applied before candidate materialization and before any V30 outcome was read.
pre_stage_a_semantic_amendment.reason: A read-only adversarial audit found that the first draft overstated registry coverage, used a 20-session project approximation for monthly return, and did not bind the compact builder and chronology-extension lineage.
pre_stage_a_semantic_amendment.changes: Rename the object turnover-PFC, use fixed causal 1/5/22-session drivers, require an exact valid 83-session chain, disclose the derived panel's exact source and universe exclusions, fail closed on null required fields, and test redundancy in both global and within-PIT-industry views.

external_prior.paper: Liu, Xufeng and Wan, Die (2022), Asymmetric positive feedback trading and stock pricing in China, North American Journal of Economics and Finance 60, 101658
external_prior.prior_used: The paper measures buying-winner feedback from return-volume lead-lag relationships, reports that the low-feedback long leg carries the anomaly, and reports stronger economics following historical good news.
external_prior.replication_boundary: This is a paper-inspired turnover-PFC chart mother, not a claimed canonical or faithful factor replication. The local derived panel supplies turnover_fraction rather than the paper's daily volume input, the public paper page does not establish that this project's exact 1/5/22-session choices reproduce the authors' full equation, and no size-neutral long-short factor is constructed.

novelty_boundary.not_previously_tested: Repository-wide exact-term and formula search found no prior positive-feedback/PFC/AFC experiment and no rolling turnover-versus-lagged-positive-return correlation signal.
novelty_boundary.why_distinct: Those experiments measure level, contemporaneous shock, displacement, or return-path shape. V30 measures whether today's turnover repeatedly covaries with already completed positive returns at three economically fixed horizons.

data.why_signal_end_is_2020_06_30: The final 2020-06-30 signal has exactly 126 global market sessions through 2020-12-31, so every plus-six-month chart remains inside the pre-2021 discovery boundary.

bounded_authorization.rule: Stage B requires a separate runner-hash-bound registry authorization after Stage A passes; registration here does not authorize outcome attachment.

lineage.pre_2018_source: Certified CY-006-schema chronology extension recorded by the bound audit; it is not globally registered CY-006.
lineage.from_2018_source: The physical chronology-extension root is not hash-identical to canonical CY-006. The bound audit certifies it as schema-exact and semantically equivalent, with an invalid-industry null encoding instead of canonical UNKNOWN; V30 makes only this bounded derived-artifact claim.
lineage.snapshot_limitation: The compact retains industry_snapshot_id but not daily snapshot_id. V30 therefore binds the immutable compact content hash plus the actual build wrapper, both imported builders, chronology audit, daily contract, and actual adjusted-coordinate source hashes and fails closed on any drift.

universe_scope.included: Shanghai Main Board excluding 688 STAR, Shenzhen 00 Main/SME, and Shenzhen 30 ChiNext.
universe_scope.interpretation: Results describe this fixed Main-plus-ChiNext derived universe, not the full A-share market.

pit_contract.required_current_row: hard_valid, current_valid, current_day_data_tradable, trade_status=1, market_rule_valid, corporate_action_valid, non-blocking, explicitly known zero current corporate_action_count, historical_identity_valid, industry_valid, non-ST, available_at<=decision_at, finite positive coordinate prices/factor, known lineage counter, amount and turnover_fraction. Null required fields fail closed.
pit_contract.history: Every correlation observation and all lag endpoints must belong to an exact consecutive market-cal_idx chain with unchanged invalid_step_cum and the same required validity contract. Missing, suspended, action-blocked, unknown-industry, or non-finite rows fail closed.
pit_contract.signal_time: Completed month-end close, available at that row's decision_at; no same-session fill is permitted.
pit_contract.coordinate: Use the bound causal action coordinate for returns and the compact builder's deterministic turnover_fraction for trading intensity. No future-adjusted vendor return or substituted volume series is allowed.

positive_feedback_representation.name: TURNOVER_PFC_1_5_22
positive_feedback_representation.window: Exactly 60 activity/driver pairs ending on the decision row, embedded in one exact 83-session consecutive, fully valid cal_idx chain so the earliest 22-session driver is causal and intact.
positive_feedback_representation.weekly_driver: max(previous-session coord_close / coord_close six sessions earlier - 1, 0)
positive_feedback_representation.monthly_driver: max(previous-session coord_close / coord_close twenty-three sessions earlier - 1, 0)
positive_feedback_representation.fixed_horizon_boundary: The project freezes broad daily/weekly/monthly proxies as 1/5/22 trading sessions. These are economically standard approximations selected before outcomes, not a claim that the unavailable full publisher equation has been reproduced.
positive_feedback_representation.components: Three Pearson correlations between current turnover_fraction and the daily, weekly, and monthly positive-return drivers over the exact 60-observation window.
positive_feedback_representation.turnover_pfc_score: Unweighted arithmetic mean of the three finite correlations.
positive_feedback_representation.nondegeneracy: Each component requires 60 finite pairs and nonzero variance in both turnover_fraction and its positive-return driver. Otherwise the security-date is ineligible.

mother_selection.clock: Last completed broad-market session of each calendar month; no day-of-month or weekday search.
mother_selection.liquidity: Current amount is at or above the same-date median among fully history-eligible securities.
mother_selection.industry_support: Causal PIT industry has at least 10 fully eligible securities on the decision date.
mother_selection.historical_good_news: Current causal ret60 is strictly positive and at or above the same-date PIT-industry median. The zero boundary makes 'prior positive price information' literal and is fixed before counts or outcomes; charts may later determine whether any simpler pre-entry structure is useful.
mother_selection.selection: Within each supported PIT industry, keep the eligible historical-good-news security with the lowest turnover_pfc_score; break ties by larger current amount and then lexical symbol.
mother_selection.cooldown: After selection, suppress the same symbol for the next 20 global market cal_idx values, applied causally in chronological order.
mother_selection.direction: Low PFC only. The direction is externally motivated and is not inferred from this repository's returns.

stage_a_representation_gate.annual_opportunity: At least 50 mother events and five independent monthly decision dates in every calendar year 2014-2020, noting that 2020 intentionally contains only January-June signals.
stage_a_representation_gate.redundancy_views: For every control report both the complete month-end history-eligible universe's same-date Spearman relationship and its supported same-date PIT-industry relationship, using only groups with at least 20 and 10 observations respectively. Liquidity and good-news filters are applied only after this gate panel is preserved.
stage_a_representation_gate.redundancy_rule: If the absolute median correlation in either frozen view is at least 0.80, close before outcomes as economically reconstructable.
stage_a_representation_gate.claim_boundary: Passing this five-proxy pairwise screen establishes exact-formula novelty and lack of trivial single-proxy reconstruction only. It does not establish economic independence from every closed family or a useful trading signal.
stage_a_representation_gate.action_if_failed: Close without changing the 60-session window, three drivers, month-end clock, historical-good-news definition, liquidity rule, industry selection, cooldown, or redundancy threshold.

frozen_development_outcome_if_stage_a_pa.entry: First legal non-limit-up open in global cal_idx +1 through +3 after the signal.
frozen_development_outcome_if_stage_a_pa.target: First later valid session whose coordinate high reaches entry coordinate price times 1.10; fill at the exact target coordinate.
frozen_development_outcome_if_stage_a_pa.fallback: First later sellable legal open strictly after 20 global market sessions from entry.
frozen_development_outcome_if_stage_a_pa.no_entry: Record NO_LEGAL_ENTRY; never substitute a close or same-session price.
frozen_development_outcome_if_stage_a_pa.lineage: Any coordinate-lineage change after entry invalidates that event; do not normalize or repair it.

chart_and_rule_plan.window: 126 global market sessions before through 126 after every mother signal, capped at 2020-12-31.
chart_and_rule_plan.review: Render every individual chart and chronological/outcome-group contact sheet; inspect every chart, explicitly including profitable, ordinary, losing, severe-loss, and incomplete cases.
chart_and_rule_plan.market_state: The existing causal close-known market regime may be annotated and may route an eventual rule, but no future state or full-period normalization is allowed.
chart_and_rule_plan.rule_freeze: All final pre-entry rules must be written and hashed before the compressed strategy outcome is aggregated.
chart_and_rule_plan.strict_development_gate: More than 50 completed signals and mean net return above 4% in every calendar year 2014-2020.
chart_and_rule_plan.validation_if_and_only_if_passed: Freeze once, then open 2022-2024 exactly once. 2021 remains unused as a temporal buffer in this workflow.

prohibited: lookback, horizon, quantile, weekday, Top-N, target, or holding-period grids
using entry-day or later candles as predictors unless a new later decision time is frozen before aggregation
relabeling turnover level, momentum, Low-MAX, or a one-day volume shock as PFC
silent missing-data substitution or relaxed PIT/action/execution gates
opening 2021 or 2022-2024 outcomes before the strict development gate
portfolio replay before the signal-level gate
